function.name: api_request_tool
function.description: Book a confirmed appointment. Do NOT call this tool until ALL of these are done, in order: (1) phone number read back digit-by-digit with a clear yes, (2) last name spelled by the caller and read back letter-by-letter with a yes, (3) the caller has been asked whether they want a text confirmation. Calling this tool before all three is a serious error.

messages.content: One moment while I get that booked.

smsConsent.description: True only if the caller clearly said yes to a text confirmation.

isNewPatient.description: True if they have not been to {{CLIENT_NAME}} before.

lastNameSpelling.description: The caller's last name exactly as they spelled it, letters only (e.g. GAONKAR). Must be collected and read back before booking.
